lines.6: 「? That's strange. My reception should've been fine... Can I see the number you have saved?」
lines.7: 「One digit is wrong here. The last number is one, not four.」
lines.9: 「S-sorry!!! Instead of a kappa swept away by the river, perhaps this is an Iruka swept away by the tide...」
lines.10: 「Punishment. Don't breathe until I say you can.」
lines.12: 「You wanted to meet with me before the family conference, didn't you?」
lines.14: 「Though we were supposed to do that a week from now.」
lines.16: 「This useless secretary got my schedule wrong.」
lines.17: 「I wasn't sure I'd have time later, so I came to talk now.」
lines.18: 「...It's about the time people start gathering.」
lines.21: 「Get in the car. I'll hear you out while I drive you.」
lines.22: 「Hah... hah... You two sound alike, you know.」
lines.24: 「I'd die if I didn't! Iruka is a mammal!」
lines.25: 「I'm leaving you behind. Find your own way back.」
lines.26: 「You two are as close as ever.」
lines.27: 「This isn't being left behind, it's just bullying, Kaname!」
lines.32: 「Phew... What should I make for dinner tonight?」
